title: kbotel's receiver exit is tested, its file's place is stated right, and the digest's ops block counts rows by their own day
goal: test_kbotel plants an idle expiry and a gone parent and sees serve return; kb/_self/usage.md says the events file is in the query log's data directory (a clone's _cache/querylog, ignored, or the plugin's data directory), not 'outside the repository'; ql_report.ops_lines counts each ops row in the ISO week of its own ts, not of its distill run, so a Monday distill does not move the previous week's rows. Found by the SP-smqwmchu review.
